messages:
Ivy: Follow-up from the RFC: proposing a light-weight "epoch_cooldown" + per-prefix proxy circuit to curb hotkey claim flapping. Basic idea: after a claim increments epoch, start cooldown_ms where reclaim attempts are rejected; old owner can optionally proxy for proxy_window_ms but only if circuit is CLOSED.

Marco: Nice. Two quick asks: (1) define error semantics for clients so routers can fast-retry; (2) ensure prefetch tasks don't commit stale data across epochs.

Dee: For 1) return structured error PREFIX_EPOCH_MISMATCH with fields {current_epoch, cooldown_remaining_ms, proxy_hint:true/false}. For 2) prefetch must carry expected_epoch and on completion validate current epoch; if mismatch then discard and enqueue read-repair.

Ivy: Implementation sketch: claim flow uses CAS on lease row `epoch` field. On success publish event. Cooldown is stored on lease record; reclaimers read lease and if epoch changed and cooldown_remaining>0 they get PREFIX_EPOCH_MISMATCH.

Marco: Proxy circuit: CLOSED allows proxying, trips OPEN when proxy latency or errors breach thresholds. When OPEN, callers get epoch error immediately. HALF_OPEN probes with limited forwards.

Dee: Compaction note: compactor must not clean tombstones with tombstone_epoch >= min_active_epoch_for_prefix. We'll surface min_active_epoch via node heartbeats so compactor can be safe.

ops-bot: Metrics proposed: prefix.epoch_mismatch.count, prefix.proxy.circuit_open.count, prefix.prefetch.discards. Logged -> https://internal/metrics/prefix-handoff

Ivy: Test plan: chaos test with 3 nodes, hotkey at 2k QPS, flip ownership rapidly, measure mismatch rate and p99. Also a skew test with simulated clock drift but rely on monotonic epoch counter rather than timestamps.

Marco: Edge case: what if proxy causes cascading load on old owner? Add per-prefix proxy_rate_limit and a global override flag so ops can short-circuit proxy entirely.

Dee: Also add small audit ring buffer on lease record: last_5_claims with (epoch, node, ts) to help postmortems. Make the ring buffer bounded and optional to avoid blowup.

Ivy: Action items: Ivy spike + bench, Marco to draft error/contract, Dee compaction gating PR, ops-bot to add metrics. Will reconvene after spike.

Marco: One more: keep CAS retries short (expo backoff to 25ms) to avoid thundering.

Dee: Sounds good. I'll start the compaction gating patch and add tests for stale write prevention.

Ivy: Thanks all. Creating tracking ticket and linking RFC.
